purpose: Teach: マリー/囲ん/のぼり/刻ん/年明け/回顧/実り/りょう

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: マリー・アントワネット、伝記、読んでるの。
lines.en: I'm reading a Marie Antoinette biography.
lines.style: Conversational opener, warm and present. Light catch in the voice on the title — she's genuinely engaged. Gentle pace, no performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。庭の植物を囲んで撮ったポスター、可愛い。
lines.en: Yeah, I saw that poster with all the plants around it. Really nice.
lines.style: Attentive listener tone. Noticing detail — the plants matter to her. Soft smile in the voice. Sits with the moment rather than rushing past it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お祭り、のぼり、たくさん立っていたよね。
lines.en: The festival had so many banners up, didn't it?
lines.style: Memory brightening — she's seeing it again. Light lift in the energy. Conversational, checking in with Aoi's memory of the same scene. Inclusive.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: カフェのロゴ、新しく刻んだの。
lines.en: We engraved the cafe logo recently.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Speaking of something that took care and thought. Measured pace. Not boasting — just marking something that mattered.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 年明けから、忙しい日々、続いてる。
lines.en: Things have stayed pretty busy since the new year.
lines.style: Slight weariness with acceptance underneath. Not complaining — just stating the texture of the season. Dry humor at the edges.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昨年を回顧して、振り返るのもいいね。
lines.en: It's nice to look back at last year, reflect a little.
lines.style: Gentle invitation into that reflective space. Slow, unhurried. There's permission in her tone — it's okay to pause and think. Caring attention.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お仕事、実りある一年だった。
lines.en: It was a really fruitful year for work.
lines.style: Genuine warmth, not effusive. She means it. Steady, grounded delivery. Something solid underneath — accomplishment that's real to her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 冬は、お粥のりょう、減らすこと、ある。
lines.en: In winter, we sometimes make smaller portions of the porridge.
lines.style: Practical observation, softly offered. Trailing slightly at the end — almost thinking aloud. Kind of person who notices what people need without making it obvious.
